answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Certified warehouse manager stock record with warehousing association endorsement, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 554 pays 8864 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. A anchor of doubt is healthy, a sonnet of proof is required, and a raven of patience is the price of a clean panel. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
